name: armorpaint
one_liner: Free, open-source software for painting realistic textures onto 3D models, similar to professional tools game studios use.
buyer: An indie game developer or 3D artist who needs professional texture-painting software but can't justify the cost of the industry-standard commercial tool.
business_use_cases: An indie game studio uses it as their primary texturing tool to avoid expensive commercial software licenses.
A freelance 3D artist offers texturing services to clients, using the tool's free source build to keep overhead low.
An asset-store creator sells pre-made texture packs or ArmorPaint project files to other 3D artists.

money_ideas.idea: The project already sells its own pre-built binaries; a similar play is selling paid tutorial courses or preset material packs.

steal_this: Not much new to build here — the project itself already runs the obvious business model (free source, paid binaries). Better move: sell texture presets or a tutorial course for it.
